symptom: Re-running the `create or modify workflow` that created a workflow with interrupting boundary events on a user task and on a call microflow left two Ends named End2, and mx check failed CE0495 'Duplicate name End2'. Reproduced on 11.16.1 with mxcli main, and on 11.17.0.
cause: The rewrite carries the stored names of the Ends it cannot state (End2 on the user task's boundary path). The call microflow's End was not carried, because an activity MDL does not name pairs by name and the rebuilt WF_Act is not the stored WF_Act4. Deduplication then numbered that End by count alone, 'End' seen twice, so End2, without checking that a carried End already held End2.
fix: uniqueName skips a suffixed name already seen, so the uncarried End gets the next free one (End3, its stored name here, which also makes the rewrite idempotent).
insight: A deduplicator that numbers by occurrence count is only sound when every name it sees went through it. Once a carry injects stored names first, the generated name must be checked against the names already taken. Test it with a carried name that equals the next generated one.
test: mdl/executor/workflow_unique_name_test.go (a carried End2 and an uncarried End: the second becomes End3); failed before (End2 twice)
